summary: Frontend re-verification after notification-link fallback fix. All 3 requested flows pass. (1) Notification dropdown items now render with fallback href=/notifications when target is empty; clicking a notif item SPA-navigates from /dashboard -> /notifications with window.__spa preserved. All 4 unread notifications for buyer@test.com show the fallback URL. (2) Regression - profile message-seller: /u/seller click profile-message-btn SPA-navigates to /messages/4 with __spa preserved. (3) Regression - auction message-seller: on auction detail, message-seller-btn SPA-navigates to /messages/3 with __spa preserved. (4) Regression - story hold-to-pause: opening a story, holding pointer on #svMedia shows .story-paused-hint display=flex and .sp-fill-active animationPlayState=paused; on pointerup animationPlayState returns to running. Note: unrelated 403 polling console errors observed as expected and ignored per instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification fallback verified: all seeded notification items expose href=/notifications when their target is empty, and Inertia <Link> triggers SPA navigation preserving window.__spa. Story close button (data-testid=story-close) closed the modal but #svMedia was still present in DOM in first pass (possibly due to next-story transition); not part of requested scope beyond dismissal - hold-to-pause behavior verified as spec. When testing SPA-preservation, ALWAYS set window.__spa AFTER page.goto() since goto is a full navigation that wipes window state.
